001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * AIDANET (AIQ) new day record 2: pump control state and sensor type.
009 */
010@HistoryLogProps(
011    opCode = 563,
012    displayName = "AIDANET Daily Status 2",
013    internalName = "LID_ANT_DAILY_STATUS2"
014)
015public class AntDailyStatus2HistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
016
017    private int pumpControlState;
018    private int sensorType;
019
020    public AntDailyStatus2HistoryLog() {}
021    public AntDailyStatus2HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
022        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0);
023    }
024
025    public AntDailyStatus2HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int pumpControlState, int sensorType) {
026        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
027        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, pumpControlState, sensorType);
028        parse(cargo);
029    }
030
031    public AntDailyStatus2HistoryLog(int pumpControlState, int sensorType) {
032        this(0, 0, pumpControlState, sensorType);
033    }
034
035    public int typeId() {
036        return 563;
037    }
038
039    /**
040     * <table border="1">
041     * <caption>Parsed fields for AntDailyStatus2HistoryLog:</caption>
042     * <tr><td><code>pumpControlState</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
043     * <tr><td><code>sensorType</code></td><td><code>raw[11] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
044     * </table>
045     */
046    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
047        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
048        this.cargo = raw;
049        parseBase(raw);
050        this.pumpControlState = raw[10] & 0xFF;
051        this.sensorType = raw[11] & 0xFF;
052    }
053
054    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
055        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0);
056    }
057
058    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int pumpControlState, int sensorType) {
059        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
060            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(563, 0),
061            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
062            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
063            new byte[]{(byte) pumpControlState},
064            new byte[]{(byte) sensorType}));
065    }
066
067    /**
068     * @return raw pump control state, see {@link DailyStatusHistoryLog.PumpControlState}
069     */
070    public int getPumpControlState() {
071        return pumpControlState;
072    }
073    /**
074     * @return raw sensor type, see {@link DailyStatusHistoryLog.SensorType}
075     */
076    public int getSensorType() {
077        return sensorType;
078    }
079}
